notes.title: Early Access Launch & Roadmap!
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers,

We are thrilled to announce the official early access release of [b]Dungeon Dungeon![/b], and we want to express our deepest gratitude for your patience and support throughout the development journey. This is a significant milestone for us, and we couldn't have reached it without you.

[b]Dungeon Dungeon![/b] is entering the early access phase, and we are excited to embark on this journey with you. Early access provides an incredible opportunity for us to collaborate with our community of players to make the game the best it can be. Your feedback, ideas, and suggestions are invaluable to us, and we encourage you to share your thoughts on the [b]Steam Forum[/b]. Together, we can shape the future of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43140540/75a42cd17c654c3d8b2e60817e7b3afb0188f95f.png[/img]
As we step into early access, we would like to provide you with a glimpse of what lies ahead. The early access period is projected to last for approximately 8 months, during which we plan to roll out a series of exciting updates and improvements. Our [b]roadmap[/b] outlines the key milestones and updates that you can expect to see as the game evolves.

Thank you for joining us on this incredible journey, and we can't wait to see how [b]Dungeon Dungeon![/b] will grow with the community. 

See you in the world of [b]Dungeon Dungeon![/b]!

notes.title: A deeper look into the combat of Dungeon Dungeon!
notes.notes:
[h2]Skills, Ults and Items[/h2]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/M63XqK0/image.gif[/img]
All units are able to perform actions including skills, ults and using items during their turns. There are over 30 skills each with its unique skill tree to upgrade with. Make sure to use skills with strategy since they have different costs. 
A wise adventurer would not go into dungeons without preparations. One small healing potion could sometimes save your valuable party member.

[h2]Positions and movement[/h2]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/KKd8FLN/1.gif[/img]
In combat, both adventurers and enemies have front positions and back positions. Units at back position are protected and take half of the damages if there are units at front. Moving wounded companions back would allow chances for healing and a comeback. 
Instead of simply moving forward or back, try to use skills that also move your companions to make the best out of it.

[h2]Attributes and effects[/h2]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/BG7SGZw/2.gif[/img]
There are all kinds of effects and buffs and debuffs. And they play a big part in the combat system of Dungeon Dungeon!. 
Even the weakest ground skeleton in the game could be fearsome if heavily buffed. So make sure to check all the buffs you can have before casting that high cost magic!

[h2]Summary[/h2]
In the combat of Dungeon Dungeon!, planning is essential. Which skills to use? Or even skip the turn to act faster next? Which enemy to focus on? With different play styles and builds, these could all have different answers.

notes.title: Welcome Adventurers!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone

We have just announced [i]Dungeon Dungeon![/i] a few days ago, and it is great to see a lot of people showing interest.

You have probably read the description on the store page already. But here we want to show you more about the game and share some exciting screenshots and GIFs!

[h2]What to expect in [i]Dungeon Dungeon![/i] [/h2]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/WWxdX1p/combat-Gif-0.gif[/img]
[h3]Turn-based Combat[/h3]
[i]Dungeon Dungeon![/i] features a unique turn-based combat system. You will be able to change the unit's orders to take turns. Utilize the effect of skills, passives and equipment to delay the enemies or hasten your companions to exploit the weakness of the enemies and protect your companions.

Furthermore, by combining with the [b]combo system[/b], you can create a rampage of attacks to crush the enemies, or save your team from a seemingly certain defeat.

[h3]Party-based RPG[/h3]
At the Early Access Release, there will be 6 companions in the game, each with unique initial skill and passives. There will also be unique permanent perks for each of the companions for you to unlock. [b]More companions[/b] are to come with the updates during the EA period.

By defeating enemies and completing quests, companions gain experiences to level up. You will be able to choose new skills, upgrade existing skills, increase attributes, and choose adventurer classes for your companions. 
[img]https://i.ibb.co/ScM90P2/screenshot-0.png[/img]
[h3]High Replayability[/h3]
Having roguelike elements in the game, we aim to provide high replayability in [i]Dungeon Dungeon![/i]. Every playthrough will be different. You will encounter different enemies in different factions. You will have different skills to choose from. And naturally we would have a good variety of enemies, skills, equipment so that players would not get bored quickly.

With our unique combat system and the amount of skills and passives, there is a possibility for all kinds of different builds. We encourage you to try different play styles, different ways to develop companions and build your party. 

[h2]What happens now till the EA release[/h2]
[i]Dungeon Dungeon![/i] is very much still in development. We are focusing on adding more contents, balancing and bug fixing to ensure that players would have the best gameplay experience when the game is released. We are also looking into the possibility to participate in [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] in February 2023 and have a [b]demo[/b] for everyone to try there. More info will come in the future if this is going to happen, so stay tuned!

[b]Follow our twitter![/b] https://twitter.com/DungeonNDungeon
[b]We post more about our game on twitter weekly.[/b]

Join our Discord Server! https://discord.gg/xEQtNZFHb2

Cheers!
Kamen Yamada
